name: indiigo-rm2
description: indiigo reMarkable: check the connection, list documents and view pages of a reMarkable 2 from Claude on macOS. Read-only. Unofficial, not affiliated with reMarkable AS.

ssh_host.title: SSH host for Wi-Fi (optional)
ssh_host.description: Leave empty to connect over the USB cable only. Set to an SSH host with key login to the tablet as root (for example rm2 from ~/.ssh/config) to fall back to Wi-Fi when the cable is not connected.
